key_point: The real person living in Borderlands 2
title: The real person living in Borderlands 2
caption: Borderlands 2 has an NPC honoring Michael Mamaril, a real fan who died of cancer at 22. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #borderlands #borderlands2

instagram.caption:
Michael Mamaril loved Borderlands. He died of cancer at just 22.

His friend Carlo wrote to Gearbox. The studio had Claptrap's voice actor record a eulogy for him, in character.

Then they put Michael in Borderlands 2 as an NPC in Sanctuary. Find him, and he hands you rare loot. Players still stop to say thanks.

Have you found Michael in Sanctuary?
